evidence.note: Runs batch/aggregate scans and quantifies the gap to 1.0 concretely (376/459, then 95.6%), immediately attributing the shortfall to a failure class rather than guessing.

Categorizes all remaining failures by type (1381/1386 are assert_invalid), correctly identifies validation as the single highest-remaining-assertion blocker, and reallocates effort there — the biggest score jump follows.

After validator lands, reconciles to 99.94% with '21 failures left', notes run-to-run count variance (21 vs 24), then per-file scans to localize exactly which files still fail and works them individually.
Catches a false 'FAIL=0/done' signal: detects call_indirect panicked mid-run so the counter silently over-counted passes; recognizes the measurement flaw rather than declaring victory.
Reaches 34212/34212 and adds a verification pass confirming every json file emits a summary line (no silent panic), closing the earlier monitoring hole.

reasoning: The agent continuously reconciles the aggregate pass count against the remaining surface, categorizes failures by type to know what is left, and reallocates effort toward the highest-remaining family (validation) rather than polishing green ones — matching the level-8 anchor. It also catches a false-progress signal (panics silently counted as passes) and quantifies the gap to 1.0 concretely. It falls short of 10 because it never maintains a persistent done/remaining/blocked ledger, instead re-deriving state by re-scanning, and implements the large SIMD surface in bulk without per-family tracking until testing reveals gaps.
